description:
Advances: specled.package

Orchestrated under epic specled_-233 (2026-07-26), shipping on one PR with specled_-vk0, specled_-gai, specled_-ymn. This ticket blocks specled_-vk0: both edit .spec/specs/package.spec.md.

## Context

From specled_-zhe cold verification (2026-07-25): specled.package.adoption_guide and specled.package.concepts_guide are `must` requirements verified by `kind: source_file`, which verifier.ex satisfies with file existence plus a substring match on the covers marker. Every content clause the requirement statements name could be deleted with spec.check staying green — which is how the N4-N11 doc rot went undetected. The fix is a content-lint test asserting the clauses exist, plus a spec-verification change in .spec/specs/package.spec.md (tagged_tests or command kind replacing/augmenting the source_file stubs). All clauses were verified present as of the specled_-zhe commit.

## Pre-flight correction (orchestrator, 2026-07-26) — the gap is NARROWER than the context above

Releases landed after this ticket was written (specled_-cz0, specled_-0x4) already added command-kind content lint. Verify current state yourself before scoping, but as of base 402f4a27:

- `adoption_guide` ALREADY has mechanical content lint: greenfield/brownfield headings, "Same as greenfield step 6: graduate", the `enforcement:` / `guardrails:` / `branch_guard:` severity-graduation tokens, and both "### Phase 4a — Aggregate coverage (zero wiring)" and "### Phase 4b — Per-test attribution (opt-in)" headings.
- The `mix spec.check` verdict read protocol ALREADY has a command-kind grep asserting the exact protocol sentence in BOTH docs/adoption.md and docs/concepts.md.
- `concepts_guide` is the REAL gap. Its only non-verdict-protocol verification is `kind: source_file, target: docs/concepts.md` — existence-only.

The clauses actually unguarded are all `concepts_guide`'s: the spec triangle (specs <-> code <-> tests), the `realized_by` tiers, the graceful-degrade rule that emits `detector_unavailable` instead of failing when a detector's prerequisites are missing, and all three drift-acceptance paths (durable `mix spec.check --accept-drift`, PR-scoped `Spec-Drift:` trailer, implementation-tier delete-and-reseed ritual).

Do NOT re-assert a clause that already has a passing grep — duplicate coverage is scope creep and will bounce. If you find a named clause is genuinely ABSENT from a doc, that means the requirement statement overclaims: report it in your completion record rather than silently editing the doc to match.

## Allowed touches

- `test/**` — the new content-lint test. A tagged_tests-covered ExUnit module is preferred over more shell greps: it asserts clause presence with readable failure messages and strengthens the existing `kind: tagged_tests` entry.
- `.spec/specs/package.spec.md` — the `spec-verification` block, so `concepts_guide` becomes content-verified rather than existence-verified. Requirement statements ONLY if you find one factually overclaims.
- `docs/concepts.md`, `docs/adoption.md` — ONLY to fix a genuinely-absent clause, and only after saying so in the completion record.
- `.spec/realization_hashes.json` — via its documented regeneration command, if the spec gate demands it.

Co-changing the `Advances:` subject spec above IS authorized: a green `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` outranks a narrow reading of Out of Scope. Do NOT weaken a requirement to make code pass.

## Out of Scope (files)

- `lib/**` — no production change is needed for this ticket.
- `test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs` and the doc-identifier lint corpus/pattern work — that is sibling ticket specled_-vk0, which edits this same spec file after you merge.
- `.spec/specs/*.spec.md` other than package.spec.md.
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `VERSION` — release-time, owned by the epic's PR step.

## Out of Scope (intent)

- No new dependencies in mix.exs.
- No refactor of the existing adoption_guide command entries; leave passing greps alone.
- Do not broaden into general docs QA. Only the clauses the two `must` statements literally name are in scope.

## Verification (gates)

Final tier is change-scoped. Do NOT run the full suite — whole-system proof runs at the orchestrator merge gate and PR CI.

1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix test <your new/edited test files>`
3. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
4. Execute the specific verification entries you added or flipped to `execute: true`.
5. FALSIFIABILITY GATE — mandatory. Prove the new content lint actually fails when a clause is removed: delete one asserted clause from docs/concepts.md locally, watch the check go red, revert before commit, and state it in your completion record. An existence-only-to-content-lint fix whose new check cannot fail is the exact defect this ticket exists to remove.
